_note: Seed data for the Phase 4 bracelet leaderboard. SOURCE: public lostark.bible CHARACTER pages (https://lostark.bible/character/{NA|CE}/<name>), read once each with a browser User-Agent, strictly sequentially, at least 3s apart. Raid-statistics endpoints were NOT touched. The data is self-reported: it is whatever the owner's roster last synced to lostark.bible, not a verified snapshot. PAYLOAD PICK: a character page embeds SEVERAL bracelet payloads and the first is not always the one the page displays. Each entry uses the payload whose combat-trait values match the page's RENDERED bracelet tooltip, and every decoded line is validated positionally against that tooltip's own words (kept here as bibleLines). SCORING: model/bracelet.js on the CANONICAL DEFAULT profile, normalizeProfile({}) — no per-player knobs. damagePct = whole bracelet (combat traits + effect lines). linesPct = effect lines only, the figure comparable to lostark.bible's own 'Bracelet Effects +X%' (biblePct) and to the 7-9% good / 10%+ near-final benchmark. goldAt1_5M = damagePct x 1,500,000 gold per 1% damage, baseline 0. KNOWN GAP: linesPct runs about +0.8pp above biblePct across the board, and about -1.5pp BELOW it for bracelets carrying family 14 (Additional Damage / Demon-Archdemon). The default profile sets demonShare=0; at demonShare=1 the family-14 gap disappears (-2.34pp spread collapses to +0.20pp), so bible values that clause at full uptime. type:2 indices 3, 4, 74, 149, 151 and type:3 index 11261 are NOT in model TYPE2_INDEX and were decoded with a local extension map; see notes[] per entry.
